scope: tests/test_ipc_data_flow_rules.py added request length mutation and alias regressions
verdict: No high-confidence unsound safe/refuted outcome identified in reviewed paths; one concrete candidate-precision regression found.

findings.summary: A merely local, unused alias invalidates a proven allocation/copy bound at declaration.
findings.detail: Both non-const reference aliases and address aliases call invalidate_request_value immediately, although no write or call through the alias has occurred. The following safe handler therefore produces ipc.parcel.copy-range: `int n=data.ReadInt32(); if(n<=0)return -1; char *dst=new char[n]; int *p=&n; const char *src=data.ReadBuffer(n); memcpy(dst,src,n);`. A reference alias has the same result. This needlessly turns a proved exact-capacity copy into a candidate, reducing the precision the static layer is intended to preserve. Invalidation should be deferred until a mutating use/escape, or otherwise distinguish a local non-escaping alias from a mutation channel.
findings.reproduction: In the integration worktree, import rules_for from tests.test_ipc_data_flow_rules and evaluate the snippets above; both returned {'ipc.parcel.copy-range'}.

coverage_notes: Reviewed path-state copying and bounded joins for request aliases/pointer aliases, local reference/address alias creation, pointer rebinding and write-through invalidation, compound/update assignments, helper/unresolved-call mutation handling, new-array capacity matching, and parser function extraction of non-const reference parameters.

Existing tests exercise direct rebinding, increment/decrement, explicit address calls, resolved reference/pointer mutators, local aliases used for mutation, pointer rebind, pointer writes, and shadowing. The suite does not currently exercise a non-const alias that is declared but never used; that uncovered the precision regression.

No concrete branch-join or partial-parse unsound safe/refuted case was demonstrated in this read-only review. Unsupported or ambiguous alias forms generally invalidate facts conservatively, which can add candidates but did not yield a demonstrated false-safe result.

verification.additional_probe: Two direct rules_for probes for unused writable pointer and reference aliases both emitted ipc.parcel.copy-range.
